content.text: No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, or early-termination fee exists anywhere in the agreement, so the preferred position is already satisfied. No redline is warranted.

input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated-damages or early-termination charge on Client, so the preferred position ("Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties") is met on the face of the document. Section 14 lets Client elect to terminate with services simply running to the last day of the following month, with no termination fee or acceleration of remaining contract value; Section 13 non-renewal likewise carries no exit payment. The compensation clause in Section 5a contains a minimum monthly charge for Hosting and Support Services, but that is consideration for services actually provided during the term, not a liquidated amount triggered by termination or breach, and Section 6 (documentation and disputes) treats it as a fee rather than a penalty. Spamming restrictions in Sections 7 and 8f are enforced by technical mechanisms and general legal/equitable remedies, with no per-incident penalty on Client. Nothing to redline.
